caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with an oval-shaped top and four turned legs. The table is shown in a three-quarter perspective view, allowing visibility of both the top and legs. The table's surface appears polished with a glossy finish, reflecting light. The apron beneath the tabletop has a scalloped edge along the front and sides. Each of the four legs is turned with decorative details and they spread out slightly at the bottom. The legs are connected near the base with horizontal stretchers forming a rectangular frame, adding stability to the structure. The overall color of the table is a warm brown with visible wood grain, and the drawing is set against an unadorned light beige background.
title: Table, Round Top
